'''Hakim Warrick''' (born [[July 8]] [[1982]] in [[Wynnewood, Pennsylvania]]) was a 4-year [[college basketball]] player for [[Syracuse University]]. Under coach [[Jim Boeheim]] and [[freshman]] [[Carmelo Anthony]], he won a [[NCAA Men's Basketball Division I Championship|national title]] with Syracuse in [[2003]] as a [[sophomore]]. 

The 6'8" (2.03 m) Warrick plans to enter the [[NBA Draft]] and is predicted to be a first round pick. In [[2005]], as a [[senior]], he won the [[Big East Men's Basketball Player of the Year]] award. His last game came against [[University of Vermont|Vermont]] in the 1st round of the [[NCAA Tournament]] when Syracuse was upset 60-57 in overtime. They were a 4 seed, Vermont was a 13 seed.
